description.zh: 资产名称，用户维度唯一，长度128字符，格式：[A-Za-z0-9_-]+。
description.en: The name of the asset. The name must be unique and can be up to 128 characters in length. Letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-) are supported.

description.zh: DRM系统中的内容ID，格式：[A-Za-z0-9_-]+，长度最多256。
description.en: The content ID in the digital rights management (DRM) system. The maximum length is 256 characters. Letters, digits, underscores (\_), and hyphens (-) are supported.
